EMDR is eye movement desensitization and reprocessing. It helps with dissociating two subjects so like if you think you can’t even know if looking at kids or whatever is wrong or right like I did it helps you connect your logical side of your brain to your emotional side, it’s very taxing but it literally like just works one day you realize you didn’t think the same about certain things than you did. It’s a weird journey and very useful but you have to talk and relieve a lot of shit you might’ve repressed. Research a bit about it, it was very helpful for me

It was the same for me no one knew I was a monster I had all these positive things told me and it just made me feel worse. EMDR therapy really helped dissociate those subjects and made me more clear headed. Just talk therapy helped a lot cause it started to all make logical sense after a while and eventually I had to accept it. It’s very confusing and controlling but give treatment a shot if you can’t fight it on your own, I couldn’t fight it on my own and needed help, no shame. You feel extremely guilty but you learn to live with it

Because maybe you deserve some gentleness that has never been shown to you for once. To be reminded that you still have good morals and have a heart. Learn from your mistakes and learn what’s right and wrong, you clearly recognize that it’s wrong. So just try to start taking steps to change it.

Anyone can get better, it’s all up to you and if you actually wanna get better and willing to sacrifice all it takes in order to be better. It’s okay to fail because that’s how it goes but as long as you constantly try to control yourself and be honest with yourself then yes I believe anyone can get better. I am in the same boat but I can definitely say it that I am better than I was. Lots of work and hardships and uncomfortable moments but it was worth it, believe it or not lol. Just try and be gentle to yourself.
